parameters.body: SELECT stock_key FROM n8n_olap.dim_stock ORDER BY stock_key FORMAT JSON

=SELECT 
   *,
   (trade_date < '{{$input.first().json.start_date}}') AS window_padding  
FROM n8n_olap.v_pre_calculate_market_data
WHERE has([{{$input.first().json.stock_keys_str}}], stock_key)
AND trade_date BETWEEN '{{$input.first().json.data_start_date}}' AND '{{$input.first().json.end_date}}'
FORMAT JSON
